requested_scope: Complete Claude-playbook 3D production including rigid-part rig, animations, materials, LODs, runtime integration and checks
user_constraints: Rigid crystal surfaces; motion at joints

next_action.action: Optional artistic review in the existing viewer; production delivery is complete.

references_hd.notes: Native skull proportions supersede slightly elongated HD head. Original and generated backgrounds inspected with alpha composition.

route: Local rigid-part construction, following Reactor and segmented-creature rules; authored native-intent motion; no Meshy jobs

agent_visual_review.method: Native/HD comparisons; Blender static views; delivered GLB browser normal and half-speed playback, intermediate samples and video filmstrip; actual GPU game captures.
coverage: front, back, side and three-quarter silhouette
face, crown, both three-claw hands, knees and feet
all three tiers indoors and outdoors against sprites
native debug action poses, including attack release at 0.833333 seconds
ordinary hostile approach/attack, damage command, backward death and default loot-satchel transition

correction_ledger.finding: Generated profile views changed camera/occluded anatomy
correction_ledger.correction: Regenerated true side views; selected v1 three-quarter over oversaturated revision. Native wedge-head proportions retained.
correction_ledger.recheck: Five selected HD views inspected against native frames.

correction_ledger.finding: World pose assignments were not parent-relative
correction_ledger.correction: Calculate matrix_basis from parent-relative rest and posed transforms.
correction_ledger.recheck: Export/master surface parity below one micron.

correction_ledger.finding: Feet were tilted; gait stance needed stable contacts
correction_ledger.correction: Level foot rings, authored two-bone leg IK, constant stance travel and smooth swing path.
correction_ledger.recheck: 48 Hz exported floor/contact and playback review passed.

correction_ledger.finding: Hands raised the fallen body off the floor
correction_ledger.correction: Place arms outward with rigid arm IK during backward fall.
correction_ledger.recheck: Corpse floor contact and hand/torso intersections passed; native death/remains inspected.

correction_ledger.finding: B/C scale_reference depended on a loaded foreign sprite family
correction_ledger.correction: Use explicit measured native scales 1, 1.299988 and 1.599991.
correction_ledger.recheck: MM8 actor regression and all-tier MM6 indoor/outdoor captures passed.

deviations: Local rigid construction and authored native-intent motion replace Meshy geometry/auto-rig and human motion retargeting. No paid Meshy jobs.
All three native tiers share palette 596, so one material is reused without redundant colour variants.
Authored LODs reduce 1216 to 916 to 664 triangles; retaining closed joints, crown and claws takes priority over approximate 50-percent steps.
Opaque crystal, matching native art: no refraction, glow or rubber-like skin blending.
Attack/cast include recovery to 1.5 seconds; release is 0.833333 seconds. Gameplay action timing is unchanged; Hit remains shorter than native 0.8125 seconds.
limits: Death interpolation floor undershoot is at most 6.3 mm; locomotion at most 2.0 mm.
